document.about: IRS Form 1040 Schedule 1 (2025), blank. Most of its lines are read as tables; what is left is a note, the part titles, and short bold labels in the margins.

notes: #240: once #230 read the form's Helvetica Neue faces by name, more of its short labels read bold. Whether the body is bold was read from the blocks the tables leave: on this form 9 bold lines of 16, so bold was taken to carry no information, and the form lost every bold heading. Over all of its glyphs, the 9pt text is mostly regular.

checks.issue: `Part I Additional Income`, the form's bold part title, was a paragraph.
